title: Symmetric laws: four levels force the standing wave
claim: Among laws w(a, b, c) = f(a, b + c) with complex weights on the level-k Sierpinski gaskets, the laws exact at levels 2, 3, 4 and 5 are exactly: the standing waves (-1)^a U_(E-1)(y/2) for complex y with their limits (-1)^a E and equality; products u(a)v(b)v(c); the laws u(a)[b = c]; and the two frozen laws [a=0][b!=c] + [a=b=c=1] and its complement (each with nonzero factors), all of them exact at every level where their factor is nonzero. Fewer levels do not suffice: generic two-sector laws u1 v1 v1 + u2 v2 v2 are exact at level 2 iff u1 is orthogonal to v2, u2 to v1 and one balance holds (a two-dimensional family); at levels 2 and 3 the waves are joined by an irreducible curve K of degree 10 with real points; at levels 2 to 4 by 16 complex laws (8 conjugate pairs), which fail level 5. Proof by the pencil classification, sector formulas, exact resultants and factorizations, 80-digit root isolation, and Groebner bases for the tangent stratum. The only knot among the laws exact at levels 2 to 5 is signed not-all-equal.
failure_conditions: A symmetric law exact at levels 2 to 5 outside the stated classes.
A stated class member that fails exactness at some level of the stated range.
A factorization, resultant or Groebner computation that does not reproduce.
foundation_claim_scope: Three-bit laws symmetric in the two non-base corners, with complex weights, on level-k Sierpinski gaskets (k = 2 to 5 and beyond for the final classes); exactness of the corner relation; the knot status of supports.

validation.status: checked: level-2 coefficient identity symbolic; sector formulas against exact integer corner relations (k = 3, 4, 5); exact resultants and factorizations at levels 3 and 4; 80-digit intersection of K with level 4 (32 points with a common ratio, 0 on the other factor, p = 0 degenerate) and level 5 failing for the 16 laws; tangent stratum by Groebner bases; rank-one stratum symbolic; final classes exact at levels 2 to 8 in exact integers; knot statuses; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: no overlap found (candidate local delta); classical tools (pencils of binary quadrics, resultants, Groebner bases)
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-29.
